A '''PanComm S-thread booth''' facilitated communications across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In [[44 ABY]], [[Vestara Khai]] sent a dispatch to a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] relay center on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]] via a public S-thread booth at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Corocus]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]].<ref name="Vortex" />
